risks_deviations: libs/golden is the Python package tests/golden/kernscope_golden/metrics.py; the C++ tolerance port in tools/capture/src/tolerance.cpp mirrors it exactly and the e2e asserts equality against the Python original (true reuse via cross-validation).
Original-VA restore is not available on HIP (HSA assigns VAs); the engine always remaps and documents CUDA VMM (cuMemAddressReserve) as the rental-gated extension point (docs/capture.md section 4).
v0 bundles carry no output blobs; replay validation takes the captured output via --ref (the e2e passes the app output). v1 bundles validate against in-bundle output snapshots.
Bench is a fixed sample count (--reps N): the libs/bench harness is configured rep_ms=0 so each convergence batch is one rep (warmup stays time-budgeted).
CUDA runtime e2e is NOT run locally: the mock-runtime chain (record->bundle->nvcc compile) is the local gate; NVIDIA runtime validation stays owner-gated via scripts/rental-validate.sh.
No bundles are uploaded anywhere (record/replay/bench are purely local).
